info.title: MusicBrainz API
info.description: The MusicBrainz API provides developers with access to the MusicBrainz Database, an extensive collection of music metadata. Designed for media applications like players and taggers, it utilizes REST principles and supports content in XML and JSON formats for easy integration.

get.description: Retrieve information about a specific area using its MusicBrainz ID
Search for areas or browse areas related to another entity
Retrieve information about a specific artist using its MusicBrainz ID. Can include recordings, releases, release-groups, and works.
Search for artists or browse artists related to another entity
Retrieve information about a specific event using its MusicBrainz ID
Search for events or browse events related to another entity
Retrieve information about a specific genre using its MusicBrainz ID
Fetch all genres, paginated, in alphabetical order. Can output as XML, JSON, or plain text.

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: Output format (json, xml, or txt for plain text)

schema.description: Newline-separated genre names in alphabetical order

get.description: Retrieve information about a specific instrument using its MusicBrainz ID
Search for instruments or browse instruments related to another entity
Retrieve information about a specific label using its MusicBrainz ID. Can include releases.
Search for labels or browse labels related to another entity
Retrieve information about a specific place using its MusicBrainz ID
Search for places or browse places related to another entity
Retrieve information about a specific recording using its MusicBrainz ID. Can include releases and release-groups.
Search for recordings or browse recordings related to another entity
Retrieve information about a specific release using its MusicBrainz ID. Can include collections, labels, recordings, and release-groups.
Search for releases or browse releases related to another entity
Retrieve information about a specific release group using its MusicBrainz ID. Can include releases.
Search for release groups or browse release groups related to another entity
Retrieve information about a specific series using its MusicBrainz ID
Search for series or browse series related to another entity
Retrieve information about a specific work using its MusicBrainz ID
Search for works or browse works related to another entity
Retrieve information about a specific URL using its MusicBrainz ID
Search for URLs or browse URLs related to another entity
Browse collections, requires authentication for private collections
Look up a release using a disc ID (TOC lookup)
Look up recordings using an International Standard Recording Code
Look up works using an International Standard Musical Work Code
Retrieve user ratings for entities (requires authentication)

post.description: Submit a rating for an entity (requires authentication, XML only)

get.description: Retrieve user tags for entities (requires authentication)

post.description: Submit tags for an entity (requires authentication, XML only)

inc.name: inc
inc.description: Include additional information. Separate multiple values with '+'. Options include: aliases, annotation, tags, ratings, user-tags, user-ratings, genres, user-genres, releases, recordings, release-groups, works, labels, collections, discids, media, isrcs, artist-credits, various-artists, area-rels, artist-rels, event-rels, genre-rels, instrument-rels, label-rels, place-rels, recording-rels, release-rels, release-group-rels, series-rels, url-rels, work-rels, recording-level-rels, release-group-level-rels, work-level-rels

query.name: query
query.description: Search query string. See search documentation for query syntax.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (maximum 100, default 25)

offset.name: offset
offset.description: Number of results to skip (for pagination)

type.name: type
type.description: Filter by release or release-group type (e.g., album, single, ep, broadcast, other)

status.name: status
status.description: Filter releases by status (e.g., official, promotion, bootleg, pseudo-release)

BadRequest.description: Bad request - invalid parameters or query

RateLimitExceeded.description: Rate limit exceeded - maximum 1 request per second

video.description: Whether this is a video recording

primary-type.description: Primary type (album, single, ep, broadcast, other)

digestAuth.description: Digest authentication using MusicBrainz username and password over HTTPS
